response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(20,10)) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL(20,10))) as bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), cross_media_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_stats), filtered_media_types AS (SELECT m.avg_unit_price, m.bytes_per_ms, c.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_stats m CROSS JOIN cross_media_avg c WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > c.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices, AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_of_bytes_per_ms, AVG(bytes_per_ms - overall_avg_bytes_per_ms) as avg_above_overall FROM filtered_media_types
